input: Find visual arts, crafts, pottery, sewing and maker summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville art summer camps 2026 pottery sewing kids
Hendersonville Brevard Black Mountain art pottery summer camp 2026 kids

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: 2026 downtown camps for rising K–12 students included painting, mixed media, paper-making and fiber arts.

candidates.name: Jan's Art Academy
candidates.note: 2026 small-group morning camps for ages 8–15 included drawing, painting, clay, crafts and papier-mâché.

candidates.name: Fired Up! Creative Lounge
candidates.note: 2026 downtown camps for ages 6–12 included pottery wheel, handbuilding, pottery painting, glass fusing and canvas painting.

candidates.name: Odyssey ClayWorks
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong clay camps offered morning and afternoon sessions with handbuilding, wheel throwing and glazing.

candidates.name: AVL clay
candidates.note: 2026 themed kids' maker camps included hands-on clay projects and supervised studio time.

candidates.name: Firefly Valley Pottery
candidates.note: West Asheville summer pottery camps combine handbuilding, individual wheel lessons, painting and natural crafts.

candidates.name: Local Cloth
candidates.note: 2026 sewing camps for ages 13–18 offered beginner instruction, upcycling and independent projects at the Depot Street studio.

candidates.name: ARTeries Fashion Sewing School
candidates.note: 2026 morning sewing camps for ages 8–15 covered fashion, costumes, design and creative sewing.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 programs included residential teen ceramics and SkillSet maker camps in woodworking, fabrication, guitar building and cosplay.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: 2026 Haw Creek pottery camps for ages 10–13 covered handbuilding, wheel throwing, decoration, glazing and firing.

candidates.name: Kids Garden Asheville
candidates.note: Summer camps for ages 3 and up include morning sessions and afternoon Art Lab & Studio camps.

candidates.name: The RAD School of Mural Arts
candidates.note: 2026 youth mural camp offered one- and two-week projects in the River Arts District.

candidates.name: Asheville Conservatory
candidates.note: 2026 creative camps combined piano and rhythm instruction with daily projects in an art studio.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Citywide youth summer camps include creative activities; 2027 schedules are scheduled for publication February 1, 2027.

candidates.name: Asheville Sun Soo Martial Arts
candidates.note: 2026 Arts/Drama-Rama camp included painting, music, dancing and singing in a full-day program.

candidates.name: LEAF Global Arts
candidates.note: 2026 youth camps included visual arts and global performing arts; youth programs transitioned to Camp Grier in September 2026.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2025–2026 children's summer camps combined themed crafts, music, dance and an end-of-week showcase.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: 2025 youth art camps included drawing, painting, wheel throwing, handbuilt creatures, printmaking and photography.

candidates.name: Waynesville Art School
candidates.note: Children's summer art camps feature painting, crafts and other hands-on creative projects.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026 camps for rising grades 1–3 included Art-tastic Creations with painting, sculpture and mixed media.

candidates.name: Penland School of Craft
candidates.note: 2026 children's craft camps and teen weekend workshops included clay, wood, textiles, drawing and painting; 2027 planning is underway.

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Arts Series for Youth offered visual and performing arts, with half-day sessions for ages 5–7.

candidates.name: Tryon Arts & Crafts School
candidates.note: Summer Sizzler offers weeklong youth art and craft camps in professionally equipped craft studios.
